description: London club staple and Livin' Proof co Founder Snips delves into Edit territory for his second release on his newly launched Barbershop Records, cleverly turning Neo Soul & RnB favourites into club ready anthems over his original productions. On the A side Jill Scott is up first, getting the afro house treatment for her early 00s smash Golden followed by an Expansions inspired re-rub of Brandy's 94 breakout single I Wanna Be Down. On Side B Snips slows things down a little with slightly more traditional Hip Hop sounds. D'angelo's Devils Pie gets a remix that would'nt have sounded out of place had it released alongside the original while New Edition's Once In A Lifetime Groove goes from 80s RnB/Pop hit to the kind of Boom Bap smash that sounds like its crying out for an MOP feature. A well varied project covering multiple genres thats a must have for any DJ.
